The second protocol is Connect. Its registration is in connect_handler.go via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`.

MemoService is served over two protocols. I am identifying the specific protocols and their registration files.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` and wrapped with Echo there too. Connect is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`, with its handler methods in `connect_services.go`.

gRPC-Gateway wrapping in v1.go uses `echo.WrapHandler` with `http.MaxBytesHandler` and auth middleware. APIV1Service implements the gRPC interface directly, so no separate wrapper exists there like in Connect.
